diff.content:
diff --git a/worker/session.py b/worker/session.py
--- a/worker/session.py
+++ b/worker/session.py
@@ -61,2 +61,14 @@ def run_once(job, control):
+    preflight = finalize_preflight(job)
+    if preflight.finalize_only:
+        control.say(
+            "Skipping agent startup; finalizing this job from the preflight "
+            f"result ({preflight.reason})."
+        )
+        finalize(job, control)
+        # `started` drives loop continuation, not "an agent ran". The loop must
+        # keep going here, so this stays True; the reporter below is what tells
+        # an operator no agent session was launched.
+        return RunSummary(started=True, reason="finalize_only")
+
     agent = start_agent(job)
     return RunSummary(started=True, reason="agent_session")
diff --git a/worker/report.py b/worker/report.py
--- a/worker/report.py
+++ b/worker/report.py
@@ -12,2 +12,5 @@ def report_summary(summary, control):
+    if summary.reason == "finalize_only":
+        control.say("continued without an agent session (finalize-only preflight)")
+        return
     if summary.started:
         control.say("started an agent session")
diff --git a/tests/test_report.py b/tests/test_report.py
--- a/tests/test_report.py
+++ b/tests/test_report.py
@@ -14,1 +14,14 @@ def test_report_summary_reports_a_started_session():
     assert "started an agent session" in control.lines
+
+
+def test_report_summary_does_not_claim_a_session_for_finalize_only():
+    control = FakeControl()
+    report_summary(RunSummary(started=True, reason="finalize_only"), control)
+    assert "started an agent session" not in control.lines
+    assert "continued without an agent session" in control.lines[0]
+
+
+def test_run_once_continues_the_loop_for_finalize_only():
+    summary = run_once(finalize_only_job(), FakeControl())
+    assert summary.started is True
+    assert summary.reason == "finalize_only"

change_contract.goal: Let the worker finalize a job straight from the preflight result without starting an agent, while keeping the run loop going and telling the operator plainly that no agent session was launched.
acceptance_criteria: A finalize-only job is finalized without starting an agent.
The run loop continues after a finalize-only job.
Operator output never claims an agent session was started for a finalize-only job.
non_goals: Redefine what `started` means to the run loop.
Change how a job is finalized.
preserved_behaviors: `started` keeps driving loop continuation and nothing else.
A job that does start an agent reports exactly as before.

repository_instructions.label: Summary field contract
repository_instructions.summary: `RunSummary.started` is the loop-continuation signal. It does not mean an agent ran, and operator-facing wording is the reporter's responsibility rather than the field's.

data: `worker/loop.py` continues iterating while `summary.started` is true and stops when it is false; it reads no other field.
Operator-facing status text is produced only by `report_summary`.
No metric or dashboard reads `started` directly.
operational: A finalize-only job is the common case during a backlog drain.
